incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED oncall-sre for p99 latency spike affecting Sunrise Telecom (dedicated pool eu2) — alert id: alert-98432. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/alerts/98432
oncall-sre: I'm up. looking at graphs now, opening war room.
alex.chen: I can join, pulled up trace and APDEX. p95 looks ok, p99 jumping to ~3.2s for text-gen endpoints in eu2.
priya.nair: customer reported slow responses for their heavy batching jobs. They said it's impacting downstream message queues.
tom.barlow: seeing elevated queue length and KV cache miss rate spike for pool eu2-dedicated-42. suspect noisy tenant.
maria.gomez: confirmed, top tenant by tokens is tenant-id: st-4321 (Sunrise Telecom). Their tail latency correlates 1:1 with spikes.
oncall-sre: can we isolate? are there spare warm instances in eu2 to shift other tenants to?
alex.chen: warm-spare eu2 has 4 nodes with capacity, but autoscaler is at max for that AZ. If we evict the noisy tenant to another region or fallback variant that may relieve p99.
priya.nair: customer requires EU data residency — can't move out of eu2. We can evict tenant from shared high-throughput nodes to a dedicated tenant-only pool in eu2 if we create one quickly.
tom.barlow: quick mitigation options: 1) throttle st-4321's max concurrency 2) evict to an isolation pool (spin a tenant-only warm pool) 3) apply temporary q-dispatch to reduce batch sizes.
oncall-sre: let's throttle first, then create isolation pool as fallback. who can throttle?
alex.chen: I can issue throttle via control plane: `redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=st-4321 --concurrency=2`
priya.nair: +1 do it, track errors to customer integration. Also notify account team.
(5s later)
alex.chen: executed: `redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=st-4321 --concurrency=2` — response OK. Adding rate-limit tag in metadata.
priya.nair: Maria, ping the account rep and let Sunrise know we're applying short-term throttle and working on isolation.
maria.gomez: pinged acct-sre and emailed sunrise-ops@sunrise.telecom. they acknowledged, said they can tolerate 30s window for rollout.
(30s later)
tom.barlow: metric check: p99 down from 3.2s to 1.1s and queue length decreased ~60%. latency still above SLO but markedly improved.
oncall-sre: good. proceed to create tenant-only pool — I'll run the provisioning job and assign st-4321 to it.
alex.chen: command to provision: `infractl create-dedicated-pool --region=eu2 --name=st-4321-isolation --size=3-gpu`
oncall-sre: running now. grabbing logs.
(2m later)
oncall-sre: pool created and nodes ready. Reconfiguring routing: `redwoodctl migrate-tenant --tenant=st-4321 --to-pool=st-4321-isolation --drain-timeout=45s`
priya.nair: monitoring for errors, will abort if we see any 5xx spike.
(1m later)
maria.gomez: acct-sre says they prefer a canary move, not big-bang. we can route 20% traffic to isolation pool first.
tom.barlow: done: `redwoodctl set-traffic-split --tenant=st-4321 --splits=80:20`
(1m later)
tom.barlow: canary looks good. p99 for st-4321 served by isolation pool ~0.9s; remaining on shared nodes ~1.2s. overall eu2 p99 back to 0.95s.
oncall-sre: nice work. keep the throttle in place for another 10m then relax if stable. create a post-incident action item to tune autoscaler thresholds and add tenant eviction policy.
priya.nair: opened ticket: INC-2026 in ops board for autoscaler tuning and tenant evict playbook. tagging eng-runtime and infra.
maria.gomez: I'll coordinate with acct-sre to offer Sunrise a follow-up call and temporary credits for disruption.
acct-sre: noted, please include timeline and mitigation steps for the customer-facing summary.
(10m later)
alex.chen: relaxing throttle: `redwoodctl tenant update --tenant=st-4321 --concurrency=8` — watching.
tom.barlow: metrics stable for 5m post-relax, no regressions.
oncall-sre: closing war room in 15 minutes unless anyone sees regression. add postmortem if we need deep dive.
priya.nair: adding logs and commands to the incident ticket. saving dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/alerts/98432?orgId=1
maria.gomez: thanks team — great coordination. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-sre. Duration: 00:24:36. Summary link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/3498765432
